summary: The upgrade carries the Bearer token and the User-Agent Sahi's CloudFront needs. Acknowledgements and the stream's non-fatal error message publish nothing. After the broker drops the socket the feed reconnects and sends the Subscribe again (Sahi subscriptions are connection-local), and ticks flow as before.

deviations.reason: A Quote frame built from a Quote tick carries no oi: the bridge keeps OI only from a Depth tick (feed/bridge.rs quote_fields with_oi), so a derivative's open interest is lost in Quote mode. The web sends the tick's open_interest, and 0 when the stream left it out (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload). The 0 for an instrument whose stream carried no OI (an equity, an index) is a value the broker did not send: lead to decide whether the desktop matches it.
The web's alias of oi, sent beside it with the same value; lost with oi in a Quote frame from a Quote tick (see oi).

Sahi's daily price band (dpr_upper, field 7) is read past by the desktop decoder (sahi/streaming/proto.rs decode_tick) and NormalizedTick has no circuit field; the web publishes it in rupees in Quote and Depth, and 0.0 when the tick left the band out.
Sahi's daily price band (dpr_lower, field 8), as upper_circuit.
